verses.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַחַ֤ת שָׁנָה֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ חֲמִיטַל בַּֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִלִּבְנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ‘eś·rîm wə·’a·ḥaṯ šā·nāh ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw wə·’a·ḥaṯ ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw ḥă·mī·ṭal baṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū mil·liḇ·nāh
verses.literal: Zedekiah was twenty-one . . . years old when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven . . . years His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah she was from Libnah
verses.literalPt: Zedequias tinha vinte e um anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou onze anos em Jerusalém. Sua mãe chamava-se Hamutal, filha de Jeremias de Libna.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה יְהוֹיָקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh yə·hō·w·yā·qîm
verses.literal: And Zedekiah did evil in the sight of the LORD just as Jehoiakim had done
verses.literalPt: Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos de Jeová, conforme tudo o que Jeoaquim fizera.

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ עַל־ אַ֣ף יְהוָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה עַד־ הִשְׁלִיכ֥וֹ אוֹתָ֖ם מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑יו וַיִּמְרֹ֥ד צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּמֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘al- ’ap̄ Yah·weh hā·yə·ṯāh bî·rū·šā·lim wî·hū·ḏāh ‘aḏ- hiš·lî·ḵōw ’ō·w·ṯām mê·‘al pā·nāw way·yim·rōḏ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū bə·me·leḵ bā·ḇel
verses.literal: For because of the anger of the LORD all this happened in Jerusalem and Judah until He finally banished them from His presence And Zedekiah also rebelled against the king of Babylon
verses.literalPt: Isto aconteceu por causa da ira de Jeová em Jerusalém até os ter lançado da sua presença. Zedequias rebelou-se contra o rei de Babilônia.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ בַשָּׁנָ֨ה הַתְּשִׁעִ֜ית לְמָלְכ֗וֹ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי֮ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ֒ בָּ֠א נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֨ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֜ל ה֤וּא וְכָל־ חֵילוֹ֙ עַל־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּבְנ֥וּ עָלֶ֛יהָ דָּיֵ֖ק סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇaš·šā·nāh hat·tə·ši·‘îṯ lə·mā·lə·ḵōw ba·ḥō·ḏeš hā·‘ă·śî·rî be·‘ā·śō·wr la·ḥō·ḏeš bā nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel hū wə·ḵāl ḥê·lōw ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim way·ya·ḥă·nū ‘ā·le·hā way·yiḇ·nū ‘ā·le·hā dā·yêq sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign on the tenth . . . day of the tenth month Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon . . . marched against Jerusalem with his entire army They encamped outside the city and built a siege wall all around it
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu que, no ano nono do seu reinado, no décimo mês, aos dez dias do mês, veio Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, com todo o seu exército contra Jerusalém, e acampou-se contra ela; e contra ela levantaram trincheiras ao redor.

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֥א הָעִ֖יר בַּמָּצ֑וֹר עַ֚ד עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō hā·‘îr bam·mā·ṣō·wr ‘aḏ ‘aš·tê ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lam·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū
verses.literal: And the city was kept under siege until King Zedekiah’s eleventh . . . year
verses.literalPt: A cidade ficou sitiada até o undécimo ano de Zedequias.

verses.original: בַּחֹ֤דֶשׁ הָֽרְבִיעִי֙ בְּתִשְׁעָ֣ה לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ וַיֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָרָעָ֖ב בָּעִ֑יר וְלֹא־ הָיָ֥ה לֶ֖חֶם לְעַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥō·ḏeš hā·rə·ḇî·‘î bə·ṯiš·‘āh la·ḥō·ḏeš way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq hā·rā·‘āḇ bā·‘îr wə·lō- hā·yāh le·ḥem lə·‘am hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: By the ninth day . . . of the fourth month the famine in the city was so severe that the people of the land had no food
verses.literalPt: No quarto mês aos nove dias do mês, viu-se a cidade apertada de fome, de modo que não havia pão para o povo da terra.

verses.original: וַתִּבָּקַ֣ע הָעִ֗יר וְכָל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֡ה יִבְרְחוּ֩ וַיֵּצְא֨וּ מֵהָעִ֜יר לַ֗יְלָה דֶּ֜רֶךְ שַׁ֤עַר בֵּין־ הַחֹמֹתַ֙יִם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ גַּ֣ן הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְכַשְׂדִּ֥ים עַל־ הָעִ֖יר סָבִ֑יב וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הָעֲרָבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tib·bā·qa‘ hā·‘îr wə·ḵāl ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh yiḇ·rə·ḥū way·yê·ṣə·’ū mê·hā·‘îr lay·lāh de·reḵ ša·‘ar bên- ha·ḥō·mō·ṯa·yim ’ă·šer ‘al- gan ham·me·leḵ wə·ḵaś·dîm ‘al- hā·‘îr sā·ḇîḇ way·yê·lə·ḵū de·reḵ hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh
verses.literal: Then the city was breached and though the Chaldeans . . . had surrounded the city all the men of war fled the city by night by way of the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden They headed toward the Arabah
verses.literalPt: Então se abriu uma brecha na cidade, e todos os homens de guerra fugiram, e saíram da cidade de noite, pelo caminho da porta entre os dois muros, a qual está junto ao jardim do rei (ora os caldeus cercavam a cidade ao redor); e foram-se pelo caminho da Arabá.

verses.original: וַיִּרְדְּפ֤וּ חֵיל־ כַּשְׂדִּים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיַּשִּׂ֥יגוּ אֶת־ צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת יְרֵח֑וֹ וְכָל־ חֵיל֔וֹ נָפֹ֖צוּ מֵעָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·də·p̄ū ḥêl- kaś·dîm ’a·ḥă·rê ham·me·leḵ way·yaś·śî·ḡū ’eṯ- ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū bə·‘ar·ḇōṯ yə·rê·ḥōw wə·ḵāl ḥê·lōw nā·p̄ō·ṣū mê·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho and his whole army deserted him
verses.literalPt: Mas o exército dos caldeus perseguiu o rei, e alcançou a Zedequias nas campinas de Jericó; todo o seu exército dispersou-se e o abandonou.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְפְּשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיַּעֲל֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ אֶל־ מֶ֧לֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל רִבְלָ֖תָה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֑ת וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ מִשְׁפָּטִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·pə·śū ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ way·ya·‘ă·lū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- me·leḵ bā·ḇel riḇ·lā·ṯāh bə·’e·reṣ ḥă·māṯ way·ḏab·bêr ’it·tōw miš·pā·ṭîm
verses.literal: The Chaldeans seized the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath where he pronounced judgment on Zedekiah
verses.literalPt: Prenderam o rei, e o levaram ao rei de Babilônia a Ribla na terra de Hamate; e ele lhe pronunciou a sentença.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁחַ֧ט מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ לְעֵינָ֑יו וְגַ֛ם אֶת־ כָּל־ שָׂרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה שָׁחַ֥ט בְּרִבְלָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ḥaṭ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ’eṯ- bə·nê ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū lə·‘ê·nāw wə·ḡam ’eṯ- kāl- śā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh šā·ḥaṭ bə·riḇ·lā·ṯāh
verses.literal: There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes and he also killed all the officials of Judah
verses.literalPt: O rei de Babilônia matou os filhos de Zedequias diante dos seus olhos; e bem assim matou todos os príncipes de Judá em Ribla.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ עֵינֵ֥י צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ עִוֵּ֑ר וַיַּאַסְרֵ֣הוּ בַֽנְחֻשְׁתַּ֗יִם וַיְבִאֵ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ בָּבֶ֔לָה וַיִּתְּנֵ֥הוּ בְבֵית הַפְּקֻדֹּ֖ת עַד־ י֥וֹם מוֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘ê·nê ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ‘iw·wêr way·ya·’as·rê·hū ḇan·ḥuš·ta·yim way·ḇi·’ê·hū me·leḵ- bā·ḇel bā·ḇe·lāh way·yit·tə·nê·hū ḇə·ḇēṯ hap·pə·qud·dōṯ ‘aḏ- yō·wm mō·w·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon where he kept him in custody . . . until his dying day
verses.literalPt: Vazou os olhos de Zedequias, atou-o com cadeias, levou-o para Babilônia e o pôs no cárcere até o dia da sua morte.

verses.original: וּבַחֹ֤דֶשׁ הַֽחֲמִישִׁי֙ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ הִ֗יא שְׁנַת֙ תְּשַֽׁע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֑ל בָּ֗א נְבֽוּזַרְאֲדָן֙ רַב־ טַבָּחִ֔ים עָמַ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇa·ḥō·ḏeš ha·ḥă·mî·šî be·‘ā·śō·wr la·ḥō·ḏeš hî šə·naṯ tə·ša‘- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lam·me·leḵ nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel bā nə·ḇū·zar·’ă·ḏān raḇ- ṭab·bā·ḥîm ‘ā·maḏ lip̄·nê me·leḵ- bā·ḇel bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: On the tenth . . . day of the fifth month in the nineteenth . . . . . . year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign over Babylon Nebuzaradan captain of the guard a servant . . . of the king of Babylon entered Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Ora no quinto mês, aos dez dias do mês, era o décimo nono ano de Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, veio a Jerusalém Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, que assistia na presença do rei de Babilônia;

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂרֹ֥ף אֶת־ בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ בָּתֵּ֧י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית הַגָּד֖וֹל שָׂרַ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·rōp̄ ’eṯ- bêṯ- Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- bêṯ ham·me·leḵ wə·’êṯ kāl- bāt·tê yə·rū·šā·lim wə·’eṯ- kāl- bêṯ hag·gā·ḏō·wl śā·rap̄ bā·’êš
verses.literal: He burned down - the house of the LORD the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem - every significant building
verses.literalPt: queimou a casa de Jeová, e a casa do rei; e todas as casas de Jerusalém, a saber, todas as casas importantes, ele as entregou às chamas.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֹמ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סָבִ֑יב נָֽתְצוּ֙ כָּל־ חֵ֣יל כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֶת־ רַב־ טַבָּחִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- kāl- ḥō·mō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim sā·ḇîḇ nā·ṯə·ṣū kāl- ḥêl kaś·dîm ’ă·šer ’eṯ- raḇ- ṭab·bā·ḥîm
verses.literal: And the whole army of the Chaldeans under the captain of the guard broke down all the walls around Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Todo o exército dos caldeus que estava com o capitão da guarda deitou abaixo em roda todos os muros de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וּמִדַּלּ֨וֹת הָעָ֜ם וְֽאֶת־ יֶ֥תֶר הָעָ֣ם׀ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּעִ֗יר וְאֶת־ הַנֹּֽפְלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽפְלוּ֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֵ֖ת יֶ֣תֶר הָֽאָמ֑וֹן הֶגְלָ֕ה נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב־ טַבָּחִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mid·dal·lō·wṯ hā·‘ām wə·’eṯ- ye·ṯer hā·‘ām han·niš·’ā·rîm bā·‘îr wə·’eṯ- han·nō·p̄ə·lîm ’ă·šer nā·p̄ə·lū ’el- me·leḵ bā·ḇel wə·’êṯ ye·ṯer hā·’ā·mō·wn heḡ·lāh nə·ḇū·zar·’ă·ḏān raḇ- ṭab·bā·ḥîm
verses.literal: Then Nebuzaradan captain of the guard carried into exile some of the poorest people and those who remained . . . . . . in the city along with the deserters who had defected to the king of Babylon and the rest of the craftsmen
verses.literalPt: Dos mais pobres da terra, e o resto do povo que havia ficado na cidade, e os desertores que se tinham passado ao rei de Babilônia, e o resto da multidão, levou-os cativos Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda.

verses.original: וּמִדַּלּ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ הִשְׁאִ֕יר נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב־ טַבָּחִ֑ים לְכֹרְמִ֖ים וּלְיֹגְבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mid·dal·lō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ hiš·’îr nə·ḇū·zar·’ă·ḏān raḇ- ṭab·bā·ḥîm lə·ḵō·rə·mîm ū·lə·yō·ḡə·ḇîm
verses.literal: But Nebuzaradan captain of the guard left behind some of the poorest of the land to tend the vineyards and fields
verses.literalPt: Mas dos mais pobres da terra deixou Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, para serem vinheiros e lavradores.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ עַמּוּדֵ֨י הַנְּחֹ֜שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֗ה וְֽאֶת־ הַמְּכֹנ֞וֹת וְאֶת־ יָ֧ם הַנְּחֹ֛שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּבֵית־ יְהוָ֖ה שִׁבְּר֣וּ כַשְׂדִּ֑ים וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ נְחֻשְׁתָּ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘am·mū·ḏê han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ă·šer lə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- yām han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh šib·bə·rū ḵaś·dîm way·yiś·’ū ’eṯ- kāl- nə·ḥuš·tām bā·ḇe·lāh
verses.literal: Moreover the Chaldeans broke up the bronze pillars and - stands and the bronze Sea in the house of the LORD and they carried all the bronze to Babylon
verses.literalPt: Os caldeus despedaçaram as colunas de cobre que estavam na casa de Jeová, e as bases, e o mar de cobre que estava na casa de Jeová, e levaram todo o cobre para Babilônia.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַ֠סִּרוֹת וְאֶת־ הַיָּעִ֨ים וְאֶת־ הַֽמְזַמְּר֜וֹת וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְרָקֹ֣ת וְאֶת־ הַכַּפּ֗וֹת וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ כְּלֵ֧י הַנְּחֹ֛שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר־ יְשָׁרְת֥וּ בָהֶ֖ם לָקָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- has·si·rō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hay·yā·‘îm wə·’eṯ- ham·zam·mə·rō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·rā·qōṯ wə·’eṯ- hak·kap·pō·wṯ wə·’êṯ kāl- kə·lê han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ă·šer- yə·šā·rə·ṯū ḇā·hem lā·qā·ḥū
verses.literal: They also took away the pots shovels wick trimmers sprinkling bowls dishes and all the articles of bronze used in the temple service
verses.literalPt: Levaram também as panelas, e as pás e os apagadores, e as bacias, e as colheres, e todos os vasos de cobre, de que usavam no ministério.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַ֠סִּפִּים וְאֶת־ הַמַּחְתּ֨וֹת וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְרָק֜וֹת וְאֶת־ הַסִּיר֣וֹת וְאֶת־ הַמְּנֹר֗וֹת וְאֶת־ הַכַּפּוֹת֙ וְאֶת־ הַמְּנַקִי֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר זָהָב֙ זָהָ֔ב וַאֲשֶׁר־ כֶּ֖סֶף כָּ֑סֶף לָקַ֖ח רַב־ טַבָּחִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- has·sip·pîm wə·’eṯ- ham·maḥ·tō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·rā·qō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- has·sî·rō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·nō·rō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hak·kap·pō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·na·qi·yō·wṯ ’ă·šer zā·hāḇ zā·hāḇ wa·’ă·šer- ke·sep̄ kā·sep̄ lā·qaḥ raḇ- ṭab·bā·ḥîm
verses.literal: The captain of the guard also took away the basins censers sprinkling bowls pots lampstands pans and drink offering bowls anything made of pure gold . . . or fine silver . . .
verses.literalPt: Levou o capitão da guarda os copos, e os braseiros, e as bacias, e as panelas, e os candeeiros, e as colheres e as taças, o que era de ouro, em ouro, e o que era de prata, em prata,

verses.original: הָעַמּוּדִ֣ים׀ שְׁנַ֗יִם הַיָּ֤ם אֶחָד֙ וְהַבָּקָ֞ר שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֤ר נְחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֣חַת הַמְּכֹנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה לֹא־ הָיָ֣ה מִשְׁקָ֔ל לִנְחֻשְׁתָּ֖ם כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm šə·na·yim hay·yām ’e·ḥāḏ wə·hab·bā·qār šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ă·šer- ta·ḥaṯ ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh lə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh lō- hā·yāh miš·qāl lin·ḥuš·tām kāl- hak·kê·lîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: As for the two pillars the Sea the twelve . . . bronze bulls under it and the movable stands that King Solomon had made for the house of the LORD . . . the weight of the bronze from all these articles was beyond measure
verses.literalPt: as duas colunas, o único mar, e os doze bois de cobre que estavam debaixo das bases, que o rei Salomão tinha feito para a casa de Jeová. O cobre de todos estes vasos não tinha peso.

verses.original: וְהָעַמּוּדִ֗ים שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה אַמָּה֙ קוֹמָה הָעַמֻּ֣ד הָאֶחָ֔ד וְח֛וּט שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה יְסֻבֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָבְי֛וֹ אַרְבַּ֥ע אַצְבָּע֖וֹת נָבֽוּב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm šə·mō·neh ‘eś·rêh ’am·māh qō·må̄h hā·‘am·muḏ hā·’e·ḥāḏ wə·ḥūṭ šə·têm- ‘eś·rêh ’am·māh yə·sub·ben·nū wə·‘ā·ḇə·yōw ’ar·ba‘ ’aṣ·bā·‘ō·wṯ nā·ḇūḇ
verses.literal: Each pillar was eighteen . . . cubits tall . . . and twelve . . . cubits in circumference each was hollow four fingers thick
verses.literalPt: Quanto às colunas, a altura de cada coluna era de dezoito cúbitos; um cordão de doze cúbitos a cercava; e a sua grossura era de quatro dedos: era oca.

verses.original: וְכֹתֶ֨רֶת עָלָ֜יו נְחֹ֗שֶׁת וְקוֹמַ֨ת הַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הָאַחַת֮ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּוֹת֒ וּשְׂבָכָ֨ה וְרִמּוֹנִ֧ים עַֽל־ הַכּוֹתֶ֛רֶת סָבִ֖יב הַכֹּ֣ל נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְכָאֵ֛לֶּה לַֽעַמּ֥וּד הַשֵּׁנִ֖י וְרִמּוֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵō·ṯe·reṯ ‘ā·lāw nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·qō·w·maṯ hak·kō·ṯe·reṯ hā·’a·ḥaṯ ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ ū·śə·ḇā·ḵāh wə·rim·mō·w·nîm ‘al- hak·kō·w·ṯe·reṯ sā·ḇîḇ hak·kōl nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·ḵā·’êl·leh la·‘am·mūḏ haš·šê·nî wə·rim·mō·w·nîm
verses.literal: The bronze capital atop one pillar was five cubits high with a network of bronze pomegranates - all around . . . The second pillar with its pomegranates was similar
verses.literalPt: Sobre ela havia um capitel de cobre; e cada capitel tinha cinco cúbitos de alto, e uma rede e romãs sobre o capitel ao redor, tudo de cobre; e a segunda coluna tinha as mesmas coisas, e romãs.

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ הָֽרִמֹּנִ֔ים תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה ר֑וּחָה כָּל־ הָרִמּוֹנִ֥ים מֵאָ֛ה עַל־ הַשְּׂבָכָ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū hā·rim·mō·nîm tiš·‘îm wə·šiš·šāh rū·ḥāh kāl- hā·rim·mō·w·nîm mê·’āh ‘al- haś·śə·ḇā·ḵāh sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Each capital had ninety-six . . . pomegranates on the sides and a total of a hundred pomegranates were above the surrounding network
verses.literalPt: Havia noventa e seis romãs aos lados; as romãs todas eram cem, postas sobre a rede ao redor.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח רַב־ טַבָּחִ֗ים אֶת־ שְׂרָיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְאֶת־ צְפַנְיָ֖ה כֹּהֵ֣ן הַמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְאֶת־ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַסַּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ raḇ- ṭab·bā·ḥîm ’eṯ- śə·rā·yāh kō·hên hā·rōš wə·’eṯ- ṣə·p̄an·yāh kō·hên ham·miš·neh wə·’eṯ- šə·lō·šeṯ šō·mə·rê has·sap̄
verses.literal: The captain of the guard also took away Seraiah the chief priest Zephaniah the priest of second rank and the three doorkeepers . . .
verses.literalPt: Levou o capitão da guarda a Seraías, o sumo sacerdote, e a Sofonias o segundo sacerdote e os três guardas da porta;

verses.original: וּמִן־ הָעִ֡יר לָקַח֩ סָרִ֨יס אֶחָ֜ד אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ הָיָ֥ה פָקִ֣יד׀ עַל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְשִׁבְעָ֨ה אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מֵרֹאֵ֤י פְנֵי־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצְא֣וּ בָעִ֔יר וְאֵ֗ת סֹפֵר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֔א הַמַּצְבִּ֖א אֶת־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ מֵעַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ הַֽנִּמְצְאִ֖ים בְּת֥וֹךְ הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- hā·‘îr lā·qaḥ sā·rîs ’e·ḥāḏ ’ăšer- hā·yāh p̄ā·qîḏ ‘al- ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’ă·nā·šîm mê·rō·’ê p̄ə·nê- ham·me·leḵ ’ă·šer nim·ṣə·’ū ḇā·‘îr wə·’êṯ sō·p̄êr śar haṣ·ṣā·ḇā ham·maṣ·bi ’eṯ- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ wə·šiš·šîm ’îš mê·‘am hā·’ā·reṣ han·nim·ṣə·’îm bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘îr
verses.literal: Of those still in the city he took a court official who had been appointed over the men of war as well as seven . . . trusted royal advisers . . . - He also took the scribe of the captain of the army who had enlisted the people of the land and sixty men . . . . . . who were found in the city
verses.literalPt: e da cidade levou a um oficial que tinha a seu cargo os homens de guerra; e a sete homens dos que assistiam ao rei e que se achavam na cidade; e ao escriba do capitão do exército que registrava o povo da terra; e sessenta homens do povo da terra, que se achavam no meio da cidade.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אוֹתָ֔ם נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב־ טַבָּחִ֑ים וַיֹּ֧לֶךְ אוֹתָ֛ם אֶל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל רִבְלָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’ō·w·ṯām nə·ḇū·zar·’ă·ḏān raḇ- ṭab·bā·ḥîm way·yō·leḵ ’ō·w·ṯām ’el- me·leḵ bā·ḇel riḇ·lā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah
verses.literalPt: Tomando-os Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, levou-os ao rei de Babilônia, a Ribla.

verses.original: וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אוֹתָם֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֧ל וַיְמִתֵ֛ם בְּרִבְלָ֖ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֑ת וַיִּ֥גֶל יְהוּדָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yak·keh ’ō·w·ṯām me·leḵ bā·ḇel way·mi·ṯêm bə·riḇ·lāh bə·’e·reṣ ḥă·māṯ way·yi·ḡel yə·hū·ḏāh mê·‘al ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: There at Riblah in the land of Hamath the king of Babylon struck them down and put them to death So Judah was taken into exile away from its own land
verses.literalPt: O rei de Babilônia os feriu, assim matando-os, em Ribla na terra de Hamate. Assim Judá foi levado cativo fora da sua terra.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶגְלָ֖ה נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֑ר בִּשְׁנַת־ שֶׁ֕בַע יְהוּדִ֕ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: zeh hā·‘ām ’ă·šer heḡ·lāh nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar biš·naṯ- še·ḇa‘ yə·hū·ḏîm šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·‘eś·rîm ū·šə·lō·šāh
verses.literal: These are the people Nebuchadnezzar carried away in the seventh year 3,023 . . . . . . . . . Jews
verses.literalPt: Esta é a gente que Nabucodonosor levou cativo: no sétimo ano três mil e vinte e três judeus;

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֛ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לִנְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֑ר מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם נֶ֕פֶשׁ שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šə·mō·w·neh ‘eś·rêh lin·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar mî·rū·šā·lim ne·p̄eš šə·mō·neh mê·’ō·wṯ šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: in Nebuchadnezzar’s eighteenth . . . year 832 . . . . . . . . . people from Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: no décimo oitavo ano de Nabucodonosor, levou de Jerusalém oitocentas e trinta e duas pessoas;

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שָׁלֹ֣שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים֮ לִנְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֒ הֶגְלָ֗ה נְבֽוּזַרְאֲדָן֙ רַב־ טַבָּחִ֔ים יְהוּדִ֕ים נֶ֕פֶשׁ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה כָּל־ נֶ֕פֶשׁ אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šā·lōš wə·‘eś·rîm lin·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar heḡ·lāh nə·ḇū·zar·’ă·ḏān raḇ- ṭab·bā·ḥîm yə·hū·ḏîm ne·p̄eš šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ ’ar·bā·‘îm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh kāl- ne·p̄eš ’ar·ba·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: in Nebuchadnezzar’s twenty-third . . . year Nebuzaradan captain of the guard carried away 745 . . . . . . . . . Jews So in all . . . 4,600 . . . . . . . . . people were taken away
verses.literalPt: no vigésimo terceiro ano de Nabucodonosor, Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, levou cativas dentre os judeus setecentas e quarenta e cinco pessoas: todas as pessoas foram quatro mil e seiscentas.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ בִשְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וָשֶׁ֜בַע שָׁנָ֗ה לְגָלוּת֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ן מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֔ה בִּשְׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ חֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ נָשָׂ֡א אֱוִ֣יל מְרֹדַךְ֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל בִּשְׁנַ֣ת מַלְכֻת֗וֹ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּצֵ֥א אוֹת֖וֹ מִבֵּ֥ית הַכְּלִיא׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇiš·lō·šîm wā·še·ḇa‘ šā·nāh lə·ḡā·lūṯ yə·hō·w·yā·ḵin me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh biš·nêm ‘ā·śār ḥō·ḏeš bə·‘eś·rîm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh la·ḥō·ḏeš nā·śā ’ĕ·wîl mə·rō·ḏaḵ me·leḵ bā·ḇel biš·naṯ mal·ḵu·ṯōw ’eṯ- rōš yə·hō·w·yā·ḵîn me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·ṣê ’ō·w·ṯōw mib·bêṯ hak·kə·lī
verses.literal: On the twenty-fifth . . . . . . day of the twelfth . . . month of the thirty-seventh . . . year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah in the first year of the reign of Evil-merodach king of Babylon he pardoned . . . Jehoiachin king of Judah and released him from prison . . .
verses.literalPt: No trigésimo sétimo ano do cativeiro de Jeoaquim, rei de Judá, no duodécimo mês aos vinte e cinco dias do mês, Evil-Merodaque, rei de Babilônia, no primeiro ano do seu reinado, levantou a cabeça de Jeoaquim, rei de Judá, e o tirou do cárcere.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ טֹב֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־ כִּסְא֔וֹ מִמַּ֗עַל לְכִסֵּ֧א מְלָכִים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בְּבָבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’it·tōw ṭō·ḇō·wṯ way·yit·tên ’eṯ- kis·’ōw mim·ma·‘al lə·ḵis·sê mə·lå̄·ḵīm ’ă·šer ’it·tōw bə·ḇā·ḇel
verses.literal: And he spoke kindly to Jehoiachin and set his throne above the thrones of the other kings who were with him in Babylon
verses.literalPt: Falou-lhe benignamente, pôs o trono dele acima dos tronos dos reis que estavam com ele em Babilônia.

verses.original: וְשִׁנָּ֕ה אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י כִלְא֑וֹ וְאָכַ֨ל לֶ֧חֶם לְפָנָ֛יו תָּמִ֖יד כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šin·nāh ’êṯ biḡ·ḏê ḵil·’ōw wə·’ā·ḵal le·ḥem lə·p̄ā·nāw tā·mîḏ kāl- yə·mê ḥay·yāw
verses.literal: So Jehoiachin changed out of his prison clothes and he dined . . . regularly at the king’s table for the rest . . . of his life
verses.literalPt: Fez-lhe mudar os vestidos de que usava no cárcere; e Jeoaquim comia pão na presença do rei continuamente todos os dias de sua vida.

verses.original: וַאֲרֻחָת֗וֹ אֲרֻחַת֩ תָּמִ֨יד נִתְּנָה־ לּ֜וֹ מֵאֵ֧ת מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל דְּבַר־ י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמ֖וֹ עַד־ י֣וֹם מוֹת֑וֹ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ru·ḥā·ṯōw ’ă·ru·ḥaṯ tā·mîḏ nit·tə·nāh- lōw mê·’êṯ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel də·ḇar- yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw ‘aḏ- yō·wm mō·w·ṯōw kōl yə·mê ḥay·yāw
verses.literal: And the king of Babylon provided . . . . . . . . . Jehoiachin . . . a daily . . . portion for the rest . . . of his life until the day of his death
verses.literalPt: Para a sua ração, foi-lhe dada pelo rei de Babilônia uma ração contínua, em cada dia a sua porção até o dia da sua morte, durante todos os dias da sua vida.
